title: An agreement allowing a step into rest

captions.energy: Increasing the speed of fulfilling duties
captions.emotions: Holding to a pace that binds

meaning: Your domestic agreement preserves freedom when performance does not become a race difficult to leave even after a sufficient result.
text: You can arrange domestic participation through clarity: agreeing tasks, recognising work and sharing what is manageable. Justice in the physical position of Muladhara describes fairness in these actions. The Chariot in energy tests your footing through accelerating, finishing sooner and immediately taking on the next stage. The Devil in emotions holds to the familiar pace and makes stopping worrying, as though domestic peace would disappear without continuous performance. An agreement can gradually bind you within duties that prevent free enjoyment of the comfort for which they were accepted.

For example, you allocate weekend jobs. The list is nearly complete, but released time fills immediately with further errands, making refusal feel unfair to the other’s effort. **Fair participation need not extend the domestic shift indefinitely.** A task can have a sufficient ending. Acknowledged work retains value without fresh proof, and home stays somewhere to live beyond continually maintaining a familiar level of mutual busyness.

The difficulty is feeling stopping as lost control or threatened equality. You continue out of loyalty while conditions expand without renewed consent. Soon, every rest needs justification. Freedom grows through clear allocation with permission to finish, where additional work is discussed afresh and previous contribution creates no indefinite duty to maintain the same speed. The agreement can then protect life as well as work.
